strongest_angle: Showrunner Terry Matalas has officially confirmed that VisionQuest takes place years after WandaVision, putting it roughly concurrent with Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

key_facts.fact: Showrunner Terry Matalas revealed in a Polygon interview that years have passed since WandaVision, placing VisionQuest roughly current with Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
Paul Bettany portrays the super-powered robot Vision, who was first introduced in the 2015 Marvel Cinematic Universe film Avengers: Age of Ultron.
GamesRadar reported that VisionQuest features the grieving synthezoid retreating into his own head and contacting his teenage son, Tommy Shepherd.
